annotation_scope: Both texts assessed using the same labels; labels describe preserved content, not a novel author-style taxonomy.

features.aggregation_horizon: Temporal aggregation, sampling interval, duration or investment horizon.
features.association_prediction_limit: Explicit limits on what association, consistency or predictability establishes.
features.comparison_ranking: Ordered comparisons or rankings, not every contrast between two concepts.
features.condition_assumption: Stated substantive condition, assumption, threshold or exception.
features.event_order_boundary: Substantive before/after ordering or time boundary; excludes citation years and document roadmap order.
features.hypothetical_numeric_values: Numerical hypothetical alternatives or counterfactual values, rather than reported observations.
features.linked_numeric_comparisons: Multiple reported values with preserved comparative roles, groups, units or periods.
features.planned_subsequent_investment_contrast: Explicit distinction between planned investment and subsequent investment; exact error subtype, not all future language.
features.probability_outcome_tuples: Explicit numerical probabilities tied to payoffs/outcomes in a choice or indifference example.
features.qualified_modality: Epistemic/modal force or uncertainty that constrains a conclusion.
features.reported_numeric_values: Substantive reported values/counts, including number words; excludes citation years, table/section indices and dates alone.
features.scope_frequency: Quantified scope, frequency, universality, negation or exclusions that must retain force.
features.stated_reason_mechanism: A reason, explanation or mechanism actually supplied by the paragraph; does not certify causality.
features.theoretical_observed_distinction: Explicit theoretical/predictive/expected versus observed/realized quantity distinction.
